capabilities: Play video and audio with a synchronized, clickable transcript from subtitle files
Highlight and comment on notes, PDFs and transcripts in sidecar .anno.json files and resurface them in a review panel
Archive remote images and videos embedded in notes to local or WebDAV caches without rewriting the markdown
Play hotlink-protected media by fetching it with the headers the source site expects
List, rename, move, delete and transcribe a media library on a self-hosted Media One server
disambiguation: Not a speech-to-text transcriber; it only plays media alongside an existing subtitle file, with transcription done by an external server.
extras: Warns that attachment-cleanup plugins such as oz-clear-unused-images and Local Images Plus may delete the archive folder; the hotlink module is desktop-only; annotation module design details live in docs/attention-architecture.md.
intentEvidence: used to be four plugins: Media Transcript, Attention, Archive Redirect and Hotlink Media. They are now modules of this one
problem: Obsidian cannot play media with synced transcripts, keep highlights and comments out of the note text, or show images and videos whose hosts block outside requests or have gone offline.
